answer: Yes, either party can terminate this contract without cause by providing prior written notice to the other party. Details: Does one party have the right to terminate or is consent or notice required of the counterparty if such party undergoes a change of control, such as a merger, stock sale, transfer of all or substantially all of its assets or business, or assignment by operation of law?

The Company has the unilateral right to assign the agreement to any entity that succeeds to substantially all of its business or assets, without requiring the Consultant's consent.
